metadata.title: Pembrolizumab, Cisplatin and 5-Fluorouracil
metadata.indication: First-line metastatic or unresectable recurrent HNSCC with PD-L1 CPS ≥1.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.

contexts.duration_text: Up to 6 combination cycles, then pembrolizumab maintenance; maximum 24 months

provenance.source: NCCP regimen PDF / Head and Neck catalogue

metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or the specialist authority specified in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00706 Version 3. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: First-line metastatic or unresectable recurrent HNSCC with PD-L1 CPS ≥1.

treatment.schedule_summary: Pembrolizumab plus cisplatin and fluorouracil every 21 days for up to 6 combination cycles, followed by pembrolizumab maintenance to a maximum total duration of 24 months.
treatment.duration_text: Up to 6 combination cycles, then pembrolizumab maintenance; maximum 24 months
